scope: assigned Linux single receive owner and optional job copy; software terminals only
covered: job consumer reads compiled firmware receipt first; prompt operation still completes from its copy
one native frame per journaled request, no acknowledgment or delimiter injection
arrival captured before post-read authority checks; cached bytes cannot refresh age
receive failure fences concurrent queued dispatch, partial writes never replay
cached assignment loss, malformed input, overflow and closure invalidate both lanes
prompt-only default has no unused job-copy backlog
limits: not an attached production sender, serial compatibility wrapper or physical job backend
no physical USB, board/screen, camera or mount qualification
read and identity callbacks must be bounded; software limits are not physical timing guarantees
